name: Plagx Draft Preflight
author: plagiarismcheckerx

sections.description:
Plagx Draft Preflight adds a Draft Preflight box to the post and page editor. Click Check draft and it reviews what you have written so far:

  • Length and structure: word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, word limits, long sentences and long paragraphs.
  • Citations and reference list: in-text citations such as (Smith, 2020) that have no entry in your References section, and references that are never cited. APA and MLA.
  • Punctuation: unmatched quotes and brackets, double spaces and spacing around punctuation.
  • Basic grammar: repeated words (“the the”), “a” / “an”, sentence capitals and common word confusions. Passive-voice hints are available as an option.

It works in the block editor and the classic editor, for posts, pages and any post type that uses the editor.

All results are automated suggestions. Draft Preflight checks structure, references, punctuation and basic grammar. It does not check originality or AI-generated text.

Privacy

Your text is checked in your browser. The plugin makes no external requests, sends no data anywhere, adds nothing to your public site and sets no cookies.

Open source

Plagx Draft Preflight uses the same rules as the open-source plagx-preflight library, which is also available for JavaScript, Python, PHP, .NET, Java and Dart. Try the live demo.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plagx-draft-preflight folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open any post or page. The Draft Preflight box is in the editor sidebar (in the block editor, under the post settings).
  4. Optional: set default word limits, citation style and checks under Settings → Draft Preflight.
sections.faq:
Does it send my content to a server?

No. Everything runs in your browser, inside the editor.

Where does it find my references?

It looks for a heading named References, Bibliography, Works Cited, Sources or similar. Each paragraph or list item after that heading counts as one reference.

Does it fix my text?

No. It lists suggestions; you decide what to change.

Does it check for plagiarism or AI-generated text?

No. For full plagiarism checking and AI-text detection, see the link on the plugin’s settings page.
